scenario.title: Research study: how students use their free time
scenario.intro: A researcher from the psychology department is interviewing students about how they spend their free time. Answer each question in about forty-five seconds.

questions.text: To start, could you tell me what you usually do in your free time during a typical week?
Can you describe a time when you learned something useful outside of class? What happened?
Some universities give students fewer assignments so that they have more free time. Do you think this is a good idea? Why or why not?
How do you think the way students spend their free time will change over the next ten years?
